text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py, reserve_stock now validates warehouse_id first via is_valid_warehouse_id from core/ids.py, raising ValueError(f\"invalid warehouse id {warehouse_id!r}\") before any ledger load or append, so malformed codes like 'WH7' are rejected and nothing is recorded; valid codes (e.g. 'WH-NVL-03') pass unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
